stories.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
stories.take: A $1.25 trillion pre-IPO mark would make OpenAI one of the most valuable companies on Earth before it sells a single public share.

stories.title: Lab testing giant Quest Diagnostics confirms patients' personal and health data was compromised during breach
stories.take: Quest is the lab behind a lot of routine bloodwork — including yours — so watch for its breach notice and what data it says was taken.

stories.title: Meta shocked by $25B fine after N.M. refused to join multistate settlement
stories.take: New Mexico held out from the group settlement and won a $25 billion judgment on its own — a template other states will study.

stories.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
stories.take: Agents are getting their own credential plumbing: scoped logins where the model never touches the actual password.

stories.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
stories.take: Canva is done renting other people's models — its first in-house image generator tightens its grip on the casual-design market.

stories.title: Arc browser sunsets December 22 as The Browser Company doubles down on Dia
stories.take: Arc gets a hard end date, Dec. 22. The Browser Company is all-in on its AI browser Dia now.

stories.title: Moderna and Merck say their mRNA cancer vaccine cut death, recurrence by 42%
stories.take: A personalized mRNA vaccine plus immunotherapy cut melanoma death and recurrence by 42% — the strongest signal yet for bespoke cancer vaccines.

stories.title: Ukraine learns to fight without Starlink as Musk plays politics with satellites
stories.take: Kyiv is building workarounds for a battlefield network one person can throttle — the dependency risk is now the story.

stories.title: Omnicom-IPG deal 'substantially completed' as group wins Coke's NA media
stories.take: The mega-merger is effectively done, and the combined holdco immediately lands Coca-Cola's North American media as proof of scale.

stories.title: McDonald's Ends 32-Year FIFA World Cup Sponsorship Amid Marketing Overhaul
stories.take: Thirty-two years of World Cup sponsorship ends — McDonald's is reallocating its biggest sports check as it reworks its whole marketing playbook.

stories.title: Advertisers Pull Meta Ads That Had Unwanted AI Glow-ups
stories.take: Brands are yanking Meta ads after the platform's AI quietly 'improved' their creative — the loss-of-control fear, made literal.

stories.title: Target's holiday push stresses affordability, exclusives and an AI assistant
stories.take: Target's holiday bet: price relief, store-only exclusives, and an AI shopping assistant doing the recommending.

stories.title: The ambitious EA Sports rebrand looks great from every angle
stories.take: A rare rebrand that earns the praise — EA Sports' new system flexes cleanly from broadcast bugs to box art.

stories.title: Apple Music's splashy new logo is gorgeous – so why isn't the new app icon?
stories.take: Apple Music's new wordmark sings and its app icon doesn't — a small masterclass in where brand systems break.

stories.title: SGA opts for 'respect' over record, subs out of blowout to end 20-point streak
stories.take: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander sat himself in a blowout and let the 20-point streak die — a record that may never be chased the same way.

stories.title: Maxey-led Sixers turn Philly boos into cheers in thrilling 29-point comeback
stories.take: Down 29 to Cleveland, Tyrese Maxey dragged the Sixers all the way back — the loudest Philly swing from boos to bedlam in years.

stories.title: Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton moved to tears following first game back from Achilles tear
stories.take: Haliburton's first game back from the Achilles tear ended in tears — the return itself was the result.

stories.title: NBA Sure Things: Three days into the new season, these nine things feel like guarantees
stories.take: Three days in, CBS locks in nine season-long certainties, from Maxey's leap to Chet Holmgren's anchor role in OKC.

stories.title: LeBron responds to Trump's criticism, calls it 'slow news day in office'
stories.take: Trump took a shot at LeBron over the anthem; LeBron shrugged it off as a slow news day and kept it moving.

stories.title: The only World Series preview you need: Predictions, likely MVPs and how many games Rays-Brewers will go
stories.take: Game 1 is tonight: two first-time-title hopefuls, and ESPN's panel splits on whether Milwaukee's power or Tampa Bay's pitching depth wins out.

stories.title: How the Rays and Brewers were made: 2026 World Series foes linked by roster-building philosophies
stories.take: The two smartest small-payroll shops in baseball meet in the Series — this is the front-office World Series as much as a players' one.

stories.title: Rays opt for Martinez to start World Series over ace Rasmussen
stories.take: Tampa Bay opens with Nick Martinez instead of its ace — a bullpen-game gambit in Game 1 of the World Series.

stories.title: Ohtani won't require surgery; Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year'
stories.take: No surgery for Ohtani and a full expectation he pitches in 2027 — the Dodgers dodge the worst-case winter.

stories.title: Scott Boras decries MLB owners who wear 'floaties' as Brewers-Rays World Series comes with salary cap debate
stories.take: Boras is using a small-market Series to argue against a salary cap: the Brewers and Rays prove spending isn't the whole story.

stories.title: Trump administration files lawsuit to block possible Democratic win in Alaska Senate race
stories.take: The Justice Department is suing to block Alaska from certifying its Senate result if the Republican loses — an extraordinary pre-election legal move.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows New Hampshire to fully ban student IDs for voting in midterms
stories.take: The Court lets New Hampshire's full ban on student IDs for voting stand for the midterms, with college towns as the obvious target.

stories.title: 2 ex-FBI officials charged with making false statements about Hunter Biden's laptop
stories.take: Two former FBI officials are charged with lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden laptop inquiries — the laptop saga enters its prosecution phase.

stories.title: Oil price rises above $115 a barrel amid fears US will renew strikes on Iran
stories.take: Oil tops $115, a five-month high, as traders price in renewed US strikes on Iran — pump prices will follow.

stories.title: Minnesota officials say US government stopped sharing evidence on fatal ICE shootings
stories.take: Minnesota investigators say federal authorities cut off evidence-sharing on fatal ICE shootings, hamstringing the state's own probes.

stories.title: Military reinforcements move to Mideast. And, millions of Americans vote early
stories.take: Another carrier heads to the Mideast while early voting surges past 2022 pace — the war and the midterms are on a collision course.

stories.title: Authorities investigating whether first Kenya and Nigeria Ebola cases crossed paths
stories.take: Investigators can't yet explain the source of Nigeria's first Ebola case — the unknown link is what has health officials worried.

stories.title: Backers of billionaire tax plan to attack Newsom in early presidential primary states
stories.take: The billionaire-tax fight goes national: backers plan ads against Newsom in early primary states, tying his presidential hopes to the tax.

stories.title: California has more revenue than expected thanks to AI. Should the state save it?
stories.take: AI money is fattening state coffers past forecasts — the Prop. 2 rainy-day question is whether Sacramento banks it or spends it.

stories.title: The millions spent by California billionaires against Prop. 40 is about 0.07% of their wealth
stories.take: The anti-Prop. 40 spend looks huge until you do the math: it's seven-hundredths of one percent of the donors' combined wealth.

stories.title: California cities pull the plug on data centers after state regulations don't scale up fast enough
stories.take: Cities aren't waiting on Sacramento — local moratoriums and rules on data centers are piling up across California.

stories.title: Self-driving Tesla hits and kills 71-year-old pedestrian on California freeway
stories.take: A self-driving Tesla struck and killed a 71-year-old pedestrian on a California freeway — expect hard questions about freeway-speed automation.

stories.title: Medi-Cal cuts could push seniors and people with disabilities off of coverage
stories.take: New Medi-Cal asset limits force seniors and disabled Californians into spend-down choices that can end their coverage.

stories.title: The iPhone Duo should have been an iPad
stories.take: The hosts' verdict: the $2,000 Duo is a great folding iPad and a poor iPhone — Nilay's score climbed 6 to 7, but David won't recommend it as a phone • Gruber: 'worst iPhone ever made, best iPad ever made' — the cramped cover screen flops, the inner OLED shines, and it's Touch ID only • Apps landed in three waves of optimization; Google apps lagged and Instagram broke at launch

stories.title: Sudan's hospitals deliberately targeted by RSF fighters
stories.take: A BBC investigation documents 40+ RSF attacks on hospitals, clinics and ambulances during the al-Fashir siege; the UN rights chief says they could amount to war crimes • Netanyahu vows a major West Bank operation after two Israeli soldiers were killed near Hebron • A personalized mRNA melanoma vaccine plus Keytruda cut recurrence and death risk 42% in a global trial • A magnitude 7 quake in Tibet killed 16 and collapsed 300+ homes at 4,800 metres

stories.title: Tornado-like damage across SoCal, Dueling federal & state fraud busts, Cole's French Dip returns— Morning Edition
stories.take: Straight-line winds, not a tornado, damaged San Clemente's golf course; a possible Victorville landspout shredded a metal shed, and Crestline took 4.5+ inches of rain in 36 hours • Feds charged 15 people in SoCal substance-abuse treatment fraud schemes totaling nearly $2 billion • AG Bonta charged 100+ Medi-Cal caregivers in a $4.5M case, then feuded with federal prosecutors over who gets credit • Cole's French Dip returns

stories.title: What’s the Deal With Billy Evans? A Spoiler-Filled Guide to ‘You Can See Everything’
stories.take: The deal: Evans is both mark and opportunist — Elizabeth Holmes' partner launched Haemanthus, a Theranos-like pet blood-testing startup that raised only ~$3M using device photos identical to the Edison • The Holmes documentary was her own orchestrated PR play and it backfired, exposing calculation instead of candor • Holmes still refuses responsibility, per Judge Davila; Theranos terrorized whistleblower Tyler Shultz, and Holmes personally lobbied Rupert Murdoch to kill the WSJ story

stories.title: US Prepares For Possible Strikes, Midterm Early Voting, Trump BBC Deposition
stories.take: The US is sending a third carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, to the Middle East as Iran strike odds rise; Brent crude hit $114 • Nearly 21 million early ballots are in, ahead of 2022 pace — Black turnout is up and Hispanic turnout has more than doubled in North Carolina and Georgia • A judge ordered Trump to sit for a deposition by Dec. 11 in his $10B BBC defamation suit, and the BBC wants his financial records

stories.title: AI Rout Finds a Floor. For Now.
stories.take: AI stocks steadied after the Nasdaq's worst day since June, though investors still question the borrowing behind the build-out; SK Hynix whipsawed after cancelling its memory unit's US listing • Public pension funds made ~$138B on AI stocks since late 2022 — 57% of their equity gains — even as states like New York and Pennsylvania fight data centers • Iran warns it will hit US warships, Gulf infrastructure and undersea cables if strikes resume; oil is at a five-month high • Western intelligence says Putin green-lit an escalated sabotage campaign on NATO soil

stories.title: The Battle Over Black Representation in the South
stories.take: After the Supreme Court's Louisiana v. Callais ruling weakened the Voting Rights Act, Louisiana, Alabama and Tennessee redrew maps — Memphis's sole majority-Black district was split into three Trump districts • South Carolina and Georgia backed off after mass protests; Mississippi, ~40% Black, is next, with hearings on Bennie Thompson's 30-year district • Organizers say the fight is energizing young Black voters; Mississippi's Senate race, with Democrat Scott Colom, is the test case

stories.title: Tim Tebow, Sage Steele and Cancel Culture: We Followed the Money Inside Life Surge
stories.take: Life Surge's own accounting exposes the funnel: events are booked as 'Cost of Lead Gen' and the high-ticket Impact Classes as 'Cost of Sales' • Merchant records show a $20,000 average ticket and $60,000 top ticket; at one event, 567 charges landed in a day, 78% of revenue in a single 30-minute window • Speaker contracts require talent to join the class upsell reception and Tebow audio encourages sign-ups — the CEO denies speakers promote classes • A ~$72.8M revenue run rate produced only $919K in net profit; a whistleblower predicts shutdown and rebrand

stories.title: Why Trump’s 2024 Voters Are Turning on Him
stories.take: Why: Trump broke his two core promises — lower prices and 'no more stupid wars.' His own tariffs and the Iran war raised costs, and voters feel betrayed • Immigration enforcement blew past 'deport criminals' into masked ICE raids; voters read it as disorder, not law and order • Corruption is now the #1 voter concern in a Fox poll because it explains why he isn't delivering; his approval has slid from over 50% to 37.5% • Data centers are the sleeper issue: rural communities fight AI builds that spike power bills while Trump sides with donors

stories.title: Meet The Millionaire Class That Really Runs America
stories.take: The class: ~3 million 'Everywhere Millionaires' worth $5M+ (average $25M) — auto dealers, beer distributors, HVAC and restaurant owners — who collectively hold about 10x the wealth of the top 400 billionaires and drive roughly half the rise in top-1% wealth • Their tax edge: the 20% pass-through deduction puts them under 30% versus 37% on wages, plus a ~$30M estate-tax exemption • Deca-millionaires hold 12% of congressional seats and 30–40% of mayoral and state legislative seats, and use state laws to protect local monopolies

stories.title: Introducing Tesla Roadster... Again
stories.take: Tesla re-introduced the Roadster — again — and Marques shot his reaction video on the iPhone Duo; viewers didn't notice the camera quality drop • The Duo deep-dive: $2,000 book-style foldable, 5.5-inch outer screen, titanium rails, Touch ID and no Face ID • Software sits in three states of optimization — Google apps are mostly unoptimized and banking apps black out in split view • Cameras lag the Pro line (4MP under-display selfie, roughly iPhone 15-era rear) despite the same A21 Pro chip; battery is 'insanely good'

stories.title: The Forgotten Godmother of Economic Literature
stories.take: Maria Edgeworth outsold Jane Austen in her day and smuggled Smith and Ricardo's economics into fiction for workers displaced by the Industrial Revolution • Barred from academic publishing, she published through novels and her father's name; her intellectual lineage runs to F.Y. Edgeworth and Jane Marcet • She shifted from strict laissez-faire to famine relief — Keynesian instincts some 80 years early — and her erasure is the point: economics keeps applying its models like physics and failing on human behavior

stories.title: CoreWeave woes, Pokémon foes, and maple syrup lows
stories.take: Bloomberg puts CoreWeave's five-year default odds at 60%: long data-center leases against short compute contracts is the WeWork pattern, with Nvidia pledged as the backstop buyer • Thieves stole ~$963,000 in graded Pokémon and sports cards from a FedEx truck outside PSA in Santa Ana; PSA will compensate owners • Quebec's strategic maple syrup reserve — about 4 million gallons, half an average harvest — has hit zero after US buyers stockpiled ahead of tariffs

stories.title: Yemen's humanitarian crisis
stories.take: More than 250,000 people are being displaced in Yemen and over 2 million children under five are acutely malnourished; an Aden unit with 22 beds can staff only 13 and is losing patients for lack of ventilators and oxygen • NYC's council voted to ban Central Park horse carriages from June 2028, ending a 160-year attraction • Nepal is the first recipient of the UN loss-and-damage fund: 119 countries have requested ~$3B against under $350M available • A retired decorator's attic Pokémon collection sold for £1.6 million
